players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: U.S. FDA Accepts sBLA for ENFLONSIA (clesrovimab-cfor) to (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA accepted a supplemental BLA to extend ENFLONSIA (clesrovimab-cfor) to prevention of RSV lower respiratory tract disease in children under two years at increased risk through their second RSV season, with a PDUFA date of March 22, 2027; the EMA accepted the matching EU application in July 2026. Both rest on the Phase 3 SMART trial. ENFLONSIA is approved in more than 40 countries for infants in their first RSV season.
quarterly_data.figure: PDUFA date March 22, 2027; approved in more than 40 countries
